notes.title: Manta Livestream
notes.content:
Experience gameplay from the upcoming Manta - a combination of flight sim, submarine sim and fleet combat.  Pilot the Manta biointerceptor as you battle across the skies and through the abyss.  Design, build and command a fleet of living warships.  Plumb the depths for lost technologies and genetic upgrades.  Defeat the Orion-Cygnus Federation and discover the secrets of the lost world of Ixt'thus!

notes.title: Manta Livesteam 2
notes.content:
Dive to the depths of the ocean and soar across the skies as we livestream the demo for our upcoming title Manta.

[previewyoutube=AkvyRxbgOyk;full][/previewyoutube]

A unique blend of flight sim, submarine sim and RTS, Manta combines fast-paced combat, stealth and fleet tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40737910/ae82f22fb8f996877b9e69c12930dc4cede330f4.png[/img]

Pilot the unique biological fighter as you dogfight against enemy fighters and submarines.  Scour the ocean floor for lost technologies.  Mine resources from the deep to build a fleet to takedown enemy capitol ships and installations - all at the same time!

[previewyoutube=NgjIPPklcDo;full][/previewyoutube]
